travel.request: Plan a WEI (weekend d'intégration) for kès, the École polytechnique student association. These are unconfirmed demo assumptions, not an approved kès trip: 100 students, departing the École polytechnique campus in Palaiseau on Friday 9 October 2026 after 17:00 and returning there on Sunday 11 October by 18:00. Use Trouville-Deauville as a provisional search area; no venue is selected. The maximum total is €120 per person including round-trip coaches, two nights of lodging, meals and transporting groceries to the venue. kès buys the groceries and transports them to the venue; students pay for these through the participation fee, with no separate meal surcharge. For this unconfirmed demo, allocate €20 per person for groceries and €2 per person for their transport within the total, not on top of it. The provisional participation fee remains €112 per person including all four components; the menu, purchases and food transport arrangements are not yet confirmed. Arrive before 21:00 and do not travel overnight. Two students each need a separate step-free room (two rooms total), to be verified with the venue. Prefer fewer changes, then an earlier return, then a lower cost. kès needs privately hired coaches with seats for all 100 students (assume two 53-seat buses for this demo), and a resort-like group venue with overnight accommodation, a shared kitchen where group cooking is permitted, and indoor and outdoor spaces where integration activities are allowed. Use Jinko lodging results as unconfirmed group estimates; private coach hire uses illustrative recorded options because ground search is unavailable for the current key. The fallback packages are not Jinko quotes. Ask the organizers to resolve requirements that the current planner cannot verify; do not assume charter availability, venue facilities or permission for activities.
